n = input()
m = sum(int(digit) for digit in n)
if(m % 3 == 0):
    d = list(n)
    d.sort(reverse= True)
    res = "".join(d)
    print(res)
else:
    print(0)

file1.full_code:
n = int(input())
lst = []

if n == 0:
    print(0)
    exit()
else:
    while n > 0:
        a = n % 10
        lst.append(a)
        n //= 10

s = sum(lst)
if s % 3 != 0:
    print(0)
else:
    lst = sorted(lst, reverse = True)
    lst = [str(x) for x in lst]
    print("".join(lst))
